profile.name: Amirhossein Saberi Fard
profile.title: Cybersecurity Specialist — Blue Team · Penetration Testing · Security Research
profile.about: Cybersecurity specialist with 4 years of hands-on experience across SOC operations, networking, and security research — including independent lab work alongside formal roles. Blue-team experience on environments serving 3000+ daily users (EPP / EDR / NDR / XDR hardening, detection tuning, incident handling). Offensive focus on vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and red teaming with Nmap, Nuclei, Burp Suite, Metasploit (msfconsole / msfvenom), plus OSINT-driven reconnaissance. Builder in Python and C++ — automation, Telegram bots, Cloudflare Workers, exploit prototypes and malware research in controlled labs and multiple realworld scenarios. Known for clear technical writing, teaching, and calm incident response.
